sources.title: Transcript: Senate Judiciary Subcommittee Hearing on Oversight of AI
sources.by: Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Privacy, Technology, and the Law
sources.quote_checked: We have built machines that are like bulls in a China shop. | The big tech company's preferred plan boils down to trust us. | somebody has to have their eyeballs on it. | with authority to call things back.

sources.title: Deep Learning Is Hitting a Wall
sources.quote_checked: Deep learning is at its best when all we need are rough-ready results. | the so-called scaling laws aren't universal laws like gravity | more fluent, but no more trustworthy. | To think that we can simply abandon symbol-manipulation is to suspend disbelief. | No single AI approach will ever be enough on its own

sources.title: Gary Marcus Wants to Tame Silicon Valley
sources.quote_checked: Companies are not taking that much responsibility. | I can't say those are impossible, but they're not our pressing concerns. | If everybody just stopped using generative AI for six months, that would have an amazing consequence. | And so, you need an agency.

sources.title: Elon Musk, these experts will bet you $500,000 that you're wrong about the future of A.I.
AI skeptic Gary Marcus on AI's moral and technical shortcomings
sources.quote_checked: Frequently wrong, never in doubt | Large language models say everything with absolute authority | the hallucinations won't go away. That's just not working | A genuinely intelligent system should be able to do a sanity check
